'''Ren'Salla''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] living in the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] within the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Ren'Salla appeared as a non-player character in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
